research_question: Does a frozen official Boltz-1 Pairformer trunk adapted to real intra-chain N/CA/C local-pose features improve contact-first partner specificity under the same SAbDab2 development split and objective?

matched_components.sequence_features: same frozen ESM authority as parent v5
matched_components.pair_labels: same authenticated complete Cartesian contact labels
matched_components.contact_decoder: same low-rank contact head, late contact-gated bidirectional cross-attention, residue marginals, and objective family

architectural_differences.self_encoder: two parameter-disjoint 48-block official Boltz-1 Pairformer trunks
architectural_differences.trainable_adapters: separate single-input, pair-input, and output projections for antibody and antigen
architectural_differences.pair_input: intra-chain full relative pose projected to the official 128-channel pair space

model_selection.checkpoint_rule: maximize the minimum of the two validation cluster-weighted directional interaction-only margins; tie-break by validation mean per-complex contact AUPRC then earlier epoch

frozen_test_action: forbidden until all development choices are frozen in a new one-time opening receipt
claim_boundary: Adapted external architecture baseline only. Source/checkpoint authentication and development performance cannot be described as native Boltz reproduction, A100 proof, frozen-test generalization, benchmark improvement, or state of the art.
